body: BLOCK exact 834f280, sole path and SHA-256 verified. Four chief findings independently confirmed at base e584ad6: HsmmResult.validated admits a nominated/admitted Viterbi state absent from its P row and explicit zero-flow keys with row-absent endpoints; revisit lacks a frozen support/flow threshold; exact recall text remains plain StorySource and needs separate disclosure authority with local-sensitive default; logLikelihood rejects NaN but admits infinities. One additional acceptance gap: section 7 has no mutation-bearing flow court for the bead-required jump, revisit, or external excursion semantics. The Association court checks row mass, not an excursion in F, so an implementation may omit all three route marks and still pass every named court. Successor should add the four chief mutations plus distinct jump, thresholded-revisit, and external-excursion flow mutations. No edit made.
